episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.summary: Tokyo's yakuza clans clash when a boss's nephew is slain, sending a rival into hiding and pulling a detective into the mystery in a very personal way.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.summary: An ambush by a criminal associate of Yuto's raises Kenzo's hopes that his brother might be alive, but carries with it the devastating possibility that Yuto doesn't want to be found - at least, not by Kenzo.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.summary: Kenzo and Yuto's reunion is not what either had hoped for. Though Kenzo finally gets some answers, he quickly finds himself back where he started - still chasing after Yuto and mystified by his brother's unexplained bitterness towards him.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.summary: A story in three chapters. As the Mori brothers end up on opposite sides of a frantic Soho gun battle, Yuto relives the split-second decisions that brought them all to this point.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.summary: In the aftermath of the gunfight, Kenzo has a choice to make: send Yuto home to face certain death, or allow the war to continue and destroy the city he's duty-bound to protect.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.summary: As the Mori family set aside their conflicts to mourn Hotaka's death, it becomes apparent that everyone has their own demons to face, courage to find or decisions to make.

episodes.title: Episode 7
episodes.summary: Ian threatens to hand incriminating photos of Yuto to the police, leaving Kenzo and Sarah divided in stopping him and forcing each to confront the mistakes of their past.

episodes.title: Episode 8
episodes.summary: When Jiro kidnaps Taki and threatens to throw her from a rooftop, the Mori brothers must decide what they're willing to sacrifice in order to save her life.
